name: First Avenue (nightclub)
description: Built in 1937 as the Greyhound bus depot, this club is where Prince recorded the album version of "Purple Rain" live in August 1983, and he rented it that fall to film the movie's concert scenes.

name: Foshay Tower
description: Wilbur Foshay built this Washington Monument look-alike in 1929 and paid John Philip Sousa $20,000 to write a march for its opening, but the check bounced when his empire collapsed weeks later, and Sousa barred the march from being played until the debt was paid.

name: Washburn Park Water Tower
description: Eight figures called the Guardians of Health ring this art deco water tower, standing watch over the city's water against pollution and bacteria.

name: Witch's Hat Tower
description: This landmark water tower was also meant to double as a bandstand that never worked out, and it opens for panoramic views just once a year.
